data: assume 10M msgs/day, 600/s peak: P(issue k | message) per 150 labels -> auto-tag, human review, or NOVEL.
message -> 150-dim multi-hot from agents' final ticket tags; catch: agents omit secondary issues -> LLM re-labels, humans audit 5% per language.
confusable pairs (duplicate charge vs refund, login vs password reset) -> mined from top false-positive pairs and teacher-student disagreements, upweighted.
long-tail labels (<200 rows) -> LLM-synthesized examples per language, real rows only for calibration; language skew -> 5% sampling floor per language.
message -> tokenize + micro-batch 10 ms -> encoder, 151 scores in 20 ms -> policy 1 ms -> tags / review / NOVEL, p99 < 50 ms.
modelTraining: char n-gram TF-IDF + one-vs-rest **logistic regression** -> misses code-switched text and low-resource languages that the encoder closes.
fine-tuned **distilled multilingual encoder** (XLM-R style): text -> pooled embedding -> 150 sigmoid heads + 1 **Unknown head** for no-known-label.
**sigmoid BCE** with per-label weights, hard negatives x3, 12-month window, Unknown head trained on human-confirmed no-label messages, retrain monthly and after NOVEL review.
per-label thresholds on calibration split -> auto-tag at precision >= 95%, review band by reviewer capacity, NOVEL if Unknown head high and labels low.

costEstimates.training: 2M rows x 150 heads / 1M rows per core-h = 300 core-h x $0.05 = ~$15
costEstimates.inference: 600 texts/s x 150 labels = 90K scores/s / 200K per core = 0.45 -> 1 core x $0.05 = ~$0.05/h

costEstimates.training: 2M rows x 3 epochs = 6M / 1.5K rows/s per GPU = 4,000 s = ~1.1 GPU-h x $4 = ~$4.4
costEstimates.inference: 600 texts/s x 1 = 600 texts/s / 5K per GPU = 0.12 -> 1 GPU x 2 replicas x $4 = ~$8/h

costSummary: Encoder costs ~$8/h (~$190/day, ~$0.00002 per message) vs ~$0.05/h baseline, worth it for cross-lingual and code-switched accuracy.
evaluationScaling: **macro-F1** and recall at 95% precision on the latest 4 weeks, per language and code-switched slices, rare labels <200 rows; Unknown AUROC with 10 labels held out; LLM labels vs human gold >= 90% agreement.

A/B on **agent override rate** of auto-tags, counter-metric ticket reopen rate; shadow -> 5% canary -> ramp, registry rollback; per-language score drift or NOVEL-rate spike -> hold ramp, widen review band.
micro-batching on 2 GPU replicas holds peak; reviewer corrections reach Labeled Data nightly; model server down -> all messages to Review Queue unscored.
